s: Today is review day, and we look back at the words from our last three lessons.
We learned words about feelings, travel, and colors.
Lena, you took a short trip last week.
Were you nervous before the trip?
I was nervous the night before.
I was nervous about the train, and I was nervous about my big bag.
The train departs at seven in the morning.
I was worried I would be late.
I was worried I would miss the train.
Were you confused at the station?
Yes, I was confused by the big signs.
The bright lights made me even more confused.
Bright signs can make anyone confused!
The gate was near the corner.
A man said, "Turn left at the corner." So I turned at the corner, and there was the gate.
Did you carry your big bag all the way to the gate?
Yes, I had to carry it.
It was heavy, but I can carry it.
I carry my bag everywhere I go.
Did the train depart on time?
When we depart, I feel better.
After we depart, I am never nervous.
How do you feel when you arrive in a new place?
When I arrive in a new city, I feel happy.
We arrive at ten in the morning, and I feel wonderful.
I bought a bright yellow shirt, and the bright shirt made me smile.

So, Maya, did I feel lonely in the new city?
I felt lonely in the hotel.
I felt lonely without my friends.
I am grateful for my friends.
I am grateful for their help.
I feel grateful every single day.
Were you surprised by anything on the trip?
I was surprised by a birthday party.
A friend gave me a party as a surprise.
I was surprised, and I was very, very surprised!
Did you feel depressed at any time on the trip?
Before the trip I felt sad, but the trip helped me.
When I travel, I am never depressed.
Travel is good for the heart.
One day the weather was awful.
The wind was awful, and the rain was awful.
Did the awful weather make the day bad?
The day was not bad at all.
The people were kind, and a bad day can still end well.
So let us look back together.
I was nervous and worried before the train departs.
Then I was confused by the bright signs, I found the gate at the corner, and I did carry my heavy bag.
The train did depart on time, and when I arrive, I feel happy.
The city was bright, and I bought a bright yellow shirt.
I felt lonely, but I am grateful for my friends, and I was surprised by the party.
I was not depressed, and even the awful weather did not make it a bad trip.
